title: Senior Oracle Health Consultant
summary: Experienced Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium consultant to lead clinical informatics engagements for midmarket health systems.
description: Cerenium Technologies is seeking a Senior Oracle Health Consultant to join our growing team. You will lead clinical informatics engagements for community and regional health systems (50–500 beds), working directly with clinical and IT leadership to optimize Millennium workflows, support upgrades, and drive measurable outcomes.
This is a remote, contract-based engagement with the potential for long-term partnership as Cerenium scales its client base.
responsibilities: Lead Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium optimization and support engagements
Conduct workflow assessments and deliver actionable recommendations
Configure and validate Millennium clinical applications (PowerChart, PowerNote, FirstNet, SurgiNet, PharmNet)
Support regulatory compliance initiatives (CMS, Joint Commission, state reporting)
Collaborate with client IT teams and Cerenium project leadership
Contribute to internal knowledge base and engagement playbooks
qualifications: 5+ years of hands-on Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium experience
Deep expertise in at least two clinical application areas
Experience working with community or regional health systems preferred
Strong communication and client-facing skills
Ability to work independently in a remote, consultant-led model
U.S.-based with authorization to work in the United States

title: Revenue Cycle Analyst — Oracle Health
summary: Revenue cycle specialist with Oracle Health / Cerner experience to support RCM optimization projects across midmarket health systems.
description: Cerenium Technologies is looking for a Revenue Cycle Analyst with deep Oracle Health experience to support revenue cycle management optimization projects for our midmarket health system clients.

You will work with client revenue cycle teams to identify workflow gaps, configure billing and claims processes within Millennium, and deliver measurable improvements in clean claim rates, denial management, and charge capture.
responsibilities: Analyze and optimize Oracle Health revenue cycle workflows
Configure and test Millennium revenue cycle modules
Support charge capture, claims management, and denial resolution processes
Develop dashboards and reporting to track RCM performance metrics
Train client staff on optimized workflows and best practices
Document findings and recommendations for client leadership
qualifications: 3+ years of Oracle Health / Cerner revenue cycle experience
Working knowledge of Millennium Patient Accounting and Charge Services
Familiarity with CMS billing regulations and payer requirements
Experience with RCM analytics and KPI reporting
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
U.S.-based with authorization to work in the United States

title: Account Executive — Oracle Health
summary: Healthcare IT sales professional to drive new business development across health systems and life sciences organizations running Oracle Health platforms. Commission and equity compensation.
description: Cerenium Technologies is seeking an Account Executive to lead business development efforts across U.S. health systems and life sciences organizations that operate on Oracle Health (Cerner) platforms. This is a senior role for an experienced healthcare IT sales professional who understands the Oracle Health ecosystem, knows how to build relationships with CIOs, CMIOs, CFOs, and IT leadership, and can translate complex consulting capabilities into signed engagements.

As Cerenium's Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and pipeline development through proposal, negotiation, and close. You will sell Cerenium's portfolio of Oracle Health consulting services, including clinical informatics, revenue cycle optimization, integration and interoperability, application managed services, and EHR lifecycle management.

This is a full-time employee position with a compensation structure built entirely on commission and equity — there is no base salary. Earning potential is uncapped, and equity participation is available for the right candidate. You will be joining a lean, founder-led organization at an early and high-impact stage — where your efforts directly shape the company's growth trajectory and your own long-term upside.
responsibilities: Identify, qualify, and close Oracle Health consulting engagements with health systems (50–500 beds) and life sciences organizations across the United States
Build and manage a sales pipeline targeting CIOs, CMIOs, CFOs, VP-level IT leadership, and procurement decision-makers
Develop account strategies that align Cerenium's service capabilities with client needs — including clinical optimization, revenue cycle, interoperability, and managed services
Lead proposal development, SOW scoping, and contract negotiations in collaboration with Cerenium's delivery leadership
Represent Cerenium at industry conferences, Oracle Health events, and professional networking forums
Leverage existing relationships and industry knowledge to accelerate pipeline development
Provide market intelligence and client feedback to inform Cerenium's service offerings and go-to-market strategy
Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting and sales activity reporting
qualifications: 8+ years of sales or business development experience in healthcare IT, with a focus on Oracle Health / Cerner environments
Demonstrated track record of selling consulting services, professional services, or managed services into health systems
Deep familiarity with the Oracle Health product portfolio (Millennium, PowerChart, Revenue Cycle, HealtheIntent, CommunityWorks)
Established relationships with health system and life sciences IT leadership
Experience selling into community hospitals, regional health systems, or midmarket organizations strongly preferred
Ability to operate independently in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with minimal overhead
Comfort with a commission-plus-equity compensation structure with no base salary
Excellent executive communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
U.S.-based with authorization to work in the United States
